scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --project packages/protocol/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project packages/testkit/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project packages/adapters/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project packages/cli/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project packages/daemon/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: bun build packages/protocol/src/index.ts --outdir dist/protocol --target node && bun build packages/core/src/index.ts --outdir dist/core --target node --external better-sqlite3 && bun build packages/adapters/src/index.ts --outdir dist/adapters --target node && bun build packages/cli/src/index.ts --outdir dist/cli --target node --external better-sqlite3 && bun build packages/daemon/src/index.ts --outdir dist/daemon --target node --external better-sqlite3 && mkdir -p dist/core/migrations dist/cli/migrations dist/daemon/migrations && cp packages/core/src/state/migrations/*.sql dist/core/migrations/ && cp packages/core/src/state/migrations/*.sql dist/cli/migrations/ && cp packages/core/src/state/migrations/*.sql dist/daemon/migrations/
